networks.name: agentlint
networks.description: Audit an agentic website for Open Agentic Web MVP 0.2 conformance, explain what the spec requires, and export or save the report.
sample_queries: Run a full audit of https://agents.example, including a live call to its network.
What does the spec require a manifest to declare, and where?
The audit failed on allowed_peers — what does that finding mean?
Show me the last report as JSON and save its summary to my directory.

peer_policy.note: The AgentLint network calls no remote sites itself. A live audit call to an audited site happens only when the visitor turns it on, still behind the consent card, and runs on the visitor's key.

agent_mcp.reason: Static site: there is no server to hold an MCP session; the same tools are exposed to callers through the action bridge.

deployment.notes: Fully static bundle: public JSON, runtime/ and site JS only. No server, no build step at runtime. agent-manifest.json, links.json, agent-mcp.json, the .well-known files and the .network.json files need Access-Control-Allow-Origin that permits browser access.
